title: About Anxious Black Girls®
tagline: A mental health brand committed to supporting anxious Black women and girls.
intro: Anxious Black Girls® exists to make mental health care feel safe, relatable, and something our community can trust. Here, we ask for nothing more than for you to show up.

founder.name: Deseray Wilson, LMHC
founder.blurb: Founder of Anxious Black Girls® and a licensed mental health counselor.
founder.bio: Deseray Wilson is a licensed mental health counselor and the founder of Anxious Black Girls®. Anxiety runs in her family, and watching the women before her stay stuck in places that didn't serve them shaped her life's work. She has helped more than 700 Black women through her virtual practice, focusing on anxiety, relationships and life transitions. She also built Supervision Support, a directory that helps pre-licensed counselors find clinical supervisors.
